title: Modelling Anomalous Diffusion: The Role of CTRWs and Non-Local Dynamics
summary: These notes provide a self-consistent summary of the stochastic approach to anomalous diffusion based on Continuous Time Random Walks (CTRWs) and their scaling limits. An introduction to CTRWs and their relationship to the theory of semi-Markov processes is provided. A general technique to study scaling limits of CTRWs is then described, and the semi-Markov property of the limiting processes is discussed.
